questions.stem: If P(A) ≠ 0 and P(B | A) = 1, what is the relationship between A and B?
questions.solution: The correct answer is A ⊂ B. If the probability of B given A is 1, it means that whenever A occurs, B must also occur, which implies that A is a subset of B. The other options are incorrect because they do not align with the definition of conditional probability.

hi.stem: यदि P(A) ≠ 0 और P(B | A) = 1, तो A और B के बीच संबंध क्या है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर A ⊂ B है। यदि B के A द्वारा प्रायिकता 1 है, तो इसका अर्थ है कि जब भी A घटित होता है, B भी घटित होता है, जो दर्शाता है कि A, B का उपसमुच्चय है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे परियाप्त प्रायिकता की परिभाषा के साथ सुमेल नहीं बैठते।

questions.stem: A box contains 10 cards numbered 1 to 10. One card is drawn at random. What is the probability that the card drawn has an even number, given that the number on the card is more than 3?
questions.solution: The probability that the card drawn has an even number given that the number is more than 3 is calculated by dividing the number of favorable outcomes (even numbers greater than 3: 4, 6, 8, 10) by the total number of outcomes greater than 3 (4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10). This gives 4/7. The option 5/7 incorrectly includes all even numbers from 1 to 10. The option 3/7 incorrectly counts only some even numbers. The option 2/7 is too low and does not match the correct count of favorable outcomes.

questions.stem: In Example 5, what is the probability of event A given that event B has occurred?
questions.solution: In Example 5, event A is getting a 4 on the third throw, and event B is getting a 6 on the first and 5 on the second throw. The probability of A given B is calculated as P(A ∩ B)/P(B). Since there is only one favorable outcome (6,5,4) out of 216 total outcomes, P(A ∩ B) = 1/216. P(B) = 1/36, so P(A|B) = (1/216)/(1/36) = 1/6. The correct answer is 1/6. The other options are incorrect because they do not match the calculated probabilities.

questions.stem: In Example 7, what is the conditional probability of the event that the die shows a number greater than 4, given that there is at least one tail?
questions.solution: In Example 7, event E is that the die shows a number greater than 4 (i.e., 5 or 6), and event F is that there is at least one tail. The favorable outcomes for E ∩ F are (T,5) and (T,6). The favorable outcomes for F are (H,T), (T,1), (T,2), (T,3), (T,4), (T,5), (T,6). So, P(E ∩ F) = 2/8 and P(F) = 7/8. Therefore, P(E|F) = (2/8)/(7/8) = 2/7. The correct answer is 2/7. The other options are incorrect because they do not match the calculated probabilities.

questions.stem: In an urn containing 10 black and 5 white balls, two balls are drawn one after the other without replacement. What is the probability that both drawn balls are black?
questions.solution: The probability of drawing a black ball first is 10/15. After one black ball is drawn, there are 9 black balls and 5 white balls left, so the probability of drawing another black ball is 9/14. Using the multiplication rule, the probability that both drawn balls are black is (10/15) × (9/14). The other options are incorrect because they use incorrect values for the second draw, either keeping the number of black balls the same or using the wrong total number of balls.

mr.stem: एका छाननीचा दोनदा फेकला जातो. मानू ए घटना 'पहिल्या फेकल्यावर विषम संख्या' आणि बी घटना 'दुसऱ्या फेकल्यावर विषम संख्या'. ए आणि बी एकत्र घडण्याची तीव्रता किती आहे?
mr.solution: एका छाननीच्या फेकल्यावर विषम संख्या मिळविण्याची तीव्रता 1/2 आहे. कारण दोन फेका स्वतंत्र आहेत, ए आणि बी एकत्र घडण्याची तीव्रता त्यांच्या विशिष्ट तीव्रतांच्या गुणाकाराच्या बरोबर आहे: 1/2 * 1/2 = 1/4. विकल्प '1/2' अयोग्य आहे कारण ते एका घटनेची तीव्रता दर्शवते, दोन्ही घटनांची नाही. विकल्प '1/3' अयोग्य आहे कारण ते गुणाकार नियमाशी जुळत नाही. विकल्प '3/4' अयोग्य आहे कारण ते स्वतंत्र घटनांसाठी शक्य असलेल्या जास्त तीव्रतेचे प्रतिनिधित्व करते.
